title: merchant.order_received, version 1
description: A paid order reached the inbox of a restaurant with at least one active merchant account, so a merchant is expected to accept it; the timeout module sets the accept deadline from occurred_at (when the inbox received the order). Not published for unstaffed restaurants. Topic merchant-events, record key: the order id, aggregate: MERCHANT_ORDER (aggregate_id = the order id).

paid_at.description: When the order was paid (the order.paid event time).

active_merchants.description: Active merchant accounts of the restaurant when the inbox received the order.
